overall_summary: Data shows high variance. One outlier video about husband-wife dynamics heavily outperformed others (1.6k views), while core emotional relationship topics like parents, siblings, and friendships hover around 100-250 views. Overall confidence is low due to limited sample size, requiring a balanced approach of repeating relationship-focused formats while testing a fresh angle.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific relational roles like spouses (or5gtaBpRVY with 1653 views) and mothers (OfHrAp3r1G8 with 225 views) drew stronger baseline interest than broad self-help or generic advice.
winning_patterns.action: Focus storytelling on specific interpersonal relationship tensions and unspoken feelings between close bonds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad motivation like 'तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं' (JPf_3ebfnuk) and low-engagement re-uploads like the sister video (jfmMztnam_A) yielded minimal traction.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic life-advice; ground every narrative in a concrete domestic or emotional situation.
